extraction.outputs: Checks, bounded stdout and per-command processManagement are copied from the redacted source report. Native stderr is omitted. No response body or result is invented.
extraction.paths: Original report placeholders <TEMP_ROOT>/<CLIENT_BIN>/<HOST_HOME> are retained. Entry digests identify only the recorded entry file; package integrity and lock digests remain separate.

validInputApplicability.limitation: These original Native stdout inputs meet the stricter enabled-field reader condition; this does not rebind the original reports or prove a new public AW chain.

isolation.homes: Independent temporary HOME/AW/Agent/XDG roots and project/neutral directories per scope.
isolation.clientInstallation: Exact public npm versions; installation scripts disabled; temporary prefixes removed.

qualificationBoundary.products: Only Copilot CLI 1.0.95 User and Project ordinary Skills in Linux, macOS and Windows x64/arm64. App and other versions or hosts are excluded.
qualificationBoundary.surface: Native marketplace registration, installation, current-body discovery, refresh, removal and user/project isolation from the AW projection candidate.
limitations: No prompts, ordinary new-session adoption, model requests or model-adoption qualification.
No Skill invocation controls, tool restriction, MCP, Hook, Agent or Instructions execution qualification.

Project fixtures set COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL=true, which also approves tools. This run uses only temporary credential-free Hosted fixtures and ordinary Skill management; it does not qualify tool execution or permission controls.

Darwin Copilot commands use approved ordinary observed mode with gradingEvidenceAccepted=false and no OS containment. They do not qualify Provider grading. The report-level generic verified-observed mode does not override these command receipts.
Linux verified-observed and Windows Job receipts only support the recorded lifecycle and discovery qualification, not other Provider, OS or profile capabilities.
Only the twelve passed Native scope cells qualify. All six source reports and all twelve Copilot public AW cells remain unverified; no original report is changed.
Public AW adapter end-to-end acceptance requires a new real report and is separate from this record.
No extrapolation to App, another version, OS, architecture, component or feature.
